messages:
devon: Heads up — we're seeing a ~30% throughput drop on dedicated pool `ded-05` starting ~03:28 UTC. p95 latency went from ~120ms -> ~420ms for gpt-neoX-20b-quant. QPS down ~2200 -> ~1500. No 429s. Affected customers: cust-phi, cust-zeta.

sre-oncall: Copy. Any recent deploys or scaling events in that window?

devon: ops-bot shows no infra deploys in that timeframe. Autoscaler didn't trigger. Main signal is continuous-batcher queue depth climbed: microbatch queue went 10 -> 90 and many microbatches processed with very small token payloads.

maria: That screams prefill/prefetch fragmentation. If we get lots of short requests (10-40 tokens) hitting a high max_batch_tokens packer, the packer may prefill KV cache and create many small microbatches which then block the scheduler.

aj: Support saw a traffic pattern change at ~03:20 — burst of small prompt validations from two clients (spikes of tiny requests, bursty but sustained). No auth/billing errors reported.

devon: Snippet from batcher log around 03:30:

```
[03:30:12] continuous-batcher[d-05-1]: schedule_window=8ms pack_token_limit=2048 prefills=83
[03:30:12] continuous-batcher[d-05-1]: created microbatch id=mb-7f2 prefill_tokens=64 kv_prefill=true
[03:30:12] continuous-batcher[d-05-1]: dispatched 83 microbatches, avg_tokens=48, wasted_prefill_tokens=5120
[03:30:13] scheduler[d-05-1]: queue_depth=92 inflight=60 waiting_for_kv=true
```

maria: That wasted_prefill_tokens number is the clue. Prefill created many KV loads for tiny batches. KV cache warmup + IO + scheduler contention increases latency and reduces useful throughput.

sam: Can we repro locally with a mixed-load script? I can run a loadtest against an isolated pool.

devon: Repro steps I used that produced the same behaviour:

1) start a small cluster `ded-05-sim` (3 nodes) with same batcher config as prod
2) run `./scripts/loadmix --rps 2000 --short 0.7 --short_len 20 --long 0.3 --long_len 600` for 10 minutes
3) observe packer logs and queue depth

Command:
```
./scripts/loadmix --pool ded-05-sim --rps 2000 --mix short=70,long=30 --duration 600
```

Results: queue depth climbs, p95 latency spikes, throughput drops ~25%.

maria: Quick mitigation suggestions:
- lower continuous_batcher.prefill_threshold from 0.3 -> 0.12 (reduces aggressive KV prefill for small requests)
- increase pack_window_ms from 8 -> 20 to allow more small requests to aggregate into fuller batches
- cap pack_token_limit to 1024 for this pool to avoid over-prefilling when requests are short

These are low-risk and config-only; don't require model restarts, just batcher config reload.

sre-oncall: I'll patch on one node first. Applying:
```
# on ded-05-n1
set-config continuous_batcher.prefill_threshold=0.12
set-config continuous_batcher.pack_window_ms=20
set-config continuous_batcher.pack_token_limit=1024
reload-service continuous-batcher
```

ops-bot: No deploys in the window. Rolling config change scheduled for ded-05. (runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/batch-tuning)

support-bot: Created incident INC-2026 for dedicated throughput drop, linked customers cust-phi, cust-zeta.

maria: After applying to n1, observed immediate drop in wasted_prefill_tokens and queue depth on that node. Throughput on n1 returned near baseline within ~90s.

sre-oncall: Rolling the same config to n2+n3 now. Monitoring QPS and p95 across pool.

devon: Thanks — do we want to roll to other dedicated pools or keep as targeted fix?

maria: Keep targeted for now; different pools have different workload mixes. We'll gather telemetry for 30m and then produce an RFC for smarter dynamic prefill logic (adaptive prefill_threshold based on short-request ratio).

sam: Logged the repro script + test output under `eng-runtime/playbooks/dedicated/batch-prefill-repro/03-19`.

sre-oncall: Update 03:50 UTC — pool-level QPS recovered to 97-102% baseline and p95 latency back to ~130ms. Closing the immediate escalation, leaving INC-2026 open for postmortem and RFC.

devon: Great work — please add notes about customers impacted and timeline to the incident ticket.

support-bot: INC-2026 updated with timeline and customers. Assigned to maria for follow-up RFC.

maria: Will draft RFC tomorrow: adaptive prefill + packer telemetry + a k/v prefill budget metric.

sre-oncall: closing thread, monitoring for 1hr. :thumbsup:
